fixture.description: Synthetic Apple Health XML: one 30-minute running workout per natural day starting 2026-01-01 (BASE_DAYS=40), 15 heart-rate records per workout; deterministic values, no RNG. Two independent SQLite databases A/B receive identical facts and identical parent releases (two full baselines at EVAL_1).
fixture.seed: deterministic: day index only (no random seed)
fixture.parentRelease: second full recompute on each database (so evidence chains read a real published run)

projection.rules: stable business keys; integers/enums/bools/null/explanation codes exact; floats abs(a-b)<=1e-9*max(1,|a|,|b|) after finite check; JSON compared recursively; extra/missing rows and dangling references fail; only run/row ids and pure execution timestamps are removed from sealed snapshot payloads.
semanticMappings: baselineEpochId / calibrationCohortHash -> compared as raw persisted values (D1 fixed; no semantic replacement)

releaseProjection.excludedExecutionIdentity: raw snapshot_hash and activated_at wall clock are execution identity, not cross-database business values

projection.note: The 15-table projection is validated by assertCompleteBusinessProjection(); a scenario missing one of these tables fails this generator.

resolvedDiscrepancy.rootCause: resumeModelReplay carried the parent checkpoint's baseline.calibrationFeatureIds (run-scoped feature ids of the parent run) into the current run; current features use new ids, so fitnessEpochId/calibrationCohortHash filtered to an empty set.
resolvedDiscrepancy.fix: remapResumedCheckpointState() maps parent calibrationFeatureIds and pendingNegativeIds through trainingSessionId to current feature ids, validates count/uniqueness/resolvability/interval/dimensions/order/throughSequence, and copies checkpoints with the remapped state_json + state_hash. Any inconsistency refuses the resume and falls back to full replay.
resolvedDiscrepancy.comparison: business-artifact-projection.ts no longer substitutes derived hashes; raw baselineEpochId/calibrationCohortHash are compared field-by-field, with lineage_hash self-verification retained.
evidence: P3-06: consecutive incremental replay keeps the raw baseline epoch stable
P3-06: a corrupt parent calibration cohort refuses the resume, never an empty cohort

resolvedDiscrepancy.backwardCompatibility: Old pre-fix checkpoints remain readable, but a parent lineage with an empty-cohort epoch is refused by the lineage guard; the first incremental after upgrade may recompute all assessments (safe fallback).
